summary.headline: Quiet day: Carney flags AI dependence, AI-designed vaccine clears trial
summary.body: A quiet day. Ahead of the G7, Canada's Mark Carney said the US order that took Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 offline shows allies must not rely on a few US models. That is a crack in Global Coordination, which nudges Gatekeeper down. A lightly sourced report of an AI-designed vaccine component passing a first human trial added a little to Capability Velocity. Horizon Balance: +1.78.
summary.movers_note: Barely any movement: Reversion -0.1, Conquerors +0.1, Zookeeper +0.1. Carney's remarks trimmed Gatekeeper (-0.07 from that event) while the vaccine report lifted capability-linked endings slightly.
coming_up: G7 leaders' summit (upcoming; referenced by Carney, date not given in the event)

events.title: Canada's Carney says US curbs on Anthropic models show AI dependence risk
events.summary: Ahead of the G7, PM Mark Carney cited the US order that took Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 offline as evidence allies must diversify away from dependence on a few US AI models.
events.reason: Allied leader openly frames US AI controls as a sovereignty risk; a rift signal, words only. Context: the US imposed the export controls on Jun 12 (pre-window) after a reported Fable 5 jailbreak.

events.title: Cambridge team reports AI-designed vaccine component passes first human trial
events.summary: Researchers said a vaccine component designed entirely by AI passed initial human safety trials.
events.reason: AI-for-science milestone; early-stage and lightly sourced.
